latest_sa.SA_STATUS, latest_sa.SA_STATUS_FLG, latest_sa.STOP_DTTM AS SA_STOP_DATE, m.MSRMT_DTTM, m.MSRMT_VAL FROM CISADM.CI_SP sp LEFT JOIN CISADM.CI_PREM p ON sp.PREM_ID = p.PREM_ID LEFT JOIN CISADM.CI_SP_TYPE spt ON sp.SP_TYPE_CD = spt.SP_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN CISADM.CI_SVC_TYPE_L svl ON spt.SVC_TYPE_CD = svl.SVC_TYPE_CD AND svl.LANGUAGE_CD = 'ENG' LEFT JOIN CISADM.CI_LOOKUP_VAL_L sl ON sp.SP_STATUS_FLG = sl.FIELD_VALUE AND sl.FIELD_NAME = 'SP_STATUS_FLG' AND sl.LANGUAGE_CD = 'ENG' -- Normalized Meter Bridge LEFT JOIN CISADM.D1_INSTALL_EVT ie ON sp.SP_ID = SUBSTR(ie.D1_SP_ID, 1, 10) LEFT JOIN CISADM.D1_MEASR_COMP mc ON ie.DEVICE_CONFIG_ID = mc.DEVICE_CONFIG_ID LEFT JOIN CISADM.D1_MSRMT m ON mc.MEASR_COMP_ID = m.MEASR_COMP_ID -- Current SA Logic LEFT JOIN ( SELECT SP_ID, SA_ID, SA_STATUS_FLG, DESCR AS SA_STATUS, STOP_DTTM FROM ( SELECT sasp.SP_ID, sa.SA_ID, sa.SA_STATUS_FLG, l.DESCR, sasp.STOP_DTTM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sasp.SP_ID ORDER BY sasp.START_DTTM DESC) as rn FROM CISADM.CI_SA_SP sasp JOIN CISADM.CI_SA sa ON sasp.SA_ID = sa.SA_ID JOIN CISADM.CI_LOOKUP_VAL_L l ON sa.SA_STATUS_FLG = l.FIELD_VALUE AND l.FIELD_NAME = 'SA_STATUS_FLG' AND l.LANGUAGE_CD = 'ENG' ) WHERE rn = 1 ) latest_sa ON sp.SP_ID = latest_sa.SP_ID</query> <sortList> <sortColumn columnName="IF_greater_MASTER_SOURCE_MSRMT_DTTM_MASTER_SOURCE_SA_STOP_DATE_Yes_No"></sortColumn>
